notable_absence.finding: This page is functionally a monitoring/inventory surface for server:node (UI Servers screen, `server-list`/`host-list` CLI commands, `/pools/default` REST) but is filed under manage/manage-nodes rather than under monitor/ - the same content (CPU/RAM/swap/disk/items per node) that a monitoring-focused extraction round would likely tag with monitoredVia relations is presented here purely as a management task. No monitoredVia relation is recorded because none of this batch's monitoring-relevant object concepts (e.g. a dedicated 'node health metrics' concept) exist yet in the registry to relate it to - flagged rather than forced.
